title: Recovering Reliable Supervision via Critique-Guided On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.20572v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model on its own rollouts with token-level supervision from a teacher, assuming that the teacher can reach a correct answer from any prefix the student writes. We call this property the recoverability of the teacher and show it fails on incorrect rollouts: the teacher follows student errors, although it recognizes them. We propose CriticOPD, using error recognition to restore recoverability. The teacher critiques an incorrect rollout, allowing the student to rewrite its solution following the error. The resulting output, including the critique as privileged information, is scored by the teacher while the student uses the revision without the critique for training. On two Qwen3 students and six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, CriticOPD improves OPD, with the largest gains on competition problems.

translated_title: 通过批评引导的在线策略蒸馏恢复可靠监督
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）利用教师模型提供的token级别监督，在学生模型自身生成的推理轨迹上进行训练，其前提假设是教师模型能够从学生所写的任意前缀出发推导出正确答案。我们将这一特性称为教师模型的可恢复性，并证明该特性在错误轨迹上会失效：教师模型虽然能够识别学生的错误，却会沿着这些错误继续推导。我们提出CriticOPD方法，利用错误识别能力来恢复可恢复性。教师模型对错误的推理轨迹进行批评点评，使学生能够针对所指出的问题重写其解答。教师模型对包含批评（作为特权信息）的完整输出进行评分，而学生则使用不含批评的修订版本进行训练。在两个Qwen3学生模型和六个数学推理基准上，CriticOPD优于传统OPD方法，其中在竞赛题目上取得了最大的性能提升。
tldr: 提出CriticOPD方法，通过教师模型对学生的错误推理轨迹进行批评点评并引导学生重写解答，恢复了在线策略蒸馏中教师监督的可靠性，在数学推理尤其是竞赛题目上显著优于传统OPD。
en_tdlr: CriticOPD restores teacher recoverability in on-policy distillation by having the teacher critique incorrect student rollouts to guide rewrites, providing reliable supervision that improves math reasoning performance, with the largest gains on competition problems.
